exposure: Eligibility for the Chiranjeevi Yojana (CY) program
cohort: 2,143 eligible women who gave birth between January and July 2013 in 142 selected villages of three districts in Gujarat, India
finding: Uptake of the CY among eligible women was low after almost a decade of implementation.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by C-section had higher odds of not utilizing the CY program.
